row.body: on the back: “before thursday lunch, a greasy sheen in the cab after the greenhouse test. my wrists blistered. later, the telephone line died.”
row.title: cab note — before thursday lunch

sidecar.gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
sidecar.rival_reading: Responders could have collected the a greasy sheen while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
